preview.processing: Full composition resized with Lanczos and encoded as lossy WebP, method 6. No crop or intentional recoloring; metadata stripped. The original JPEG has no embedded ICC profile and orientation is 1.

photographicInspiration.use: Named by the project owner as visual inspiration. A credited, locally hosted preview appears in the page and loads lazily without JavaScript. Only explicit source-link navigation loads the original. No palette-sampling, photographer endorsement or theme/code MIT grant is claimed.

music.processing: Encode the full stereo track at 128 kbps MP3, preserve 48 kHz sample rate, strip source metadata; no trimming, gain, speed or pitch change
music.use: Website-only looping playback. Eligible fresh visible loads preload during the intro and attempt playback after dive completion; skipped or reduced-motion intros can complete immediately. If autoplay is blocked, a pending request retries on genuine page gestures without requiring the Play button, subject to browser policy. Explicit cancel/pause, real failures, hidden/pagehide and history restoration suppress automatic retries. Not part of native themes or their MIT grant.
